newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo March construction work rises sharply.
newsitem.headline: Yugo March construction work rises sharply.

text.p: reported the following economic indicator details.
CONSTRUCTION WORKS IN YUGOSLAVIA MAR FEB MAR 96
NOTES -- Cumulative number of workers in the January-March period was seven percent below the same three months last year.
Cumulative number of hours put in by workers in January-March dropped by six percent on the same three-month period last year.

At the end of March, the value of concluded building contracts stood at 1.547 billion dinars, compared to 1.054 billion in February. The data refer to contracted construction works to be carried out during the year regardless of when the orders were made.
The data covers major construction companies accounting for around 80 percent of total annual value of construction works.
The number of workers excludes engineers and technicians. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 4305
